Worrell et al., Bistable and photoswitchable states of matter, 2018,
DOI 10.1038/s41467-018-05300-7:
https://d-nb.info/1168577934/34

stress relaxation when a base enables exchange. Local photocaged-base release
and photoacid inhibition are demonstrated starting operations; the read text
uses different prepared formulations for the two directions. A one-way persistent

relaxation after illumination and short post-switch observations do not establish
long loaded retention, a stiff structural body or an autonomous writer. The first
